name: develop
summary: Develop a ticket or task with explicit choices for selection, acceptance, merge and partial work. The first option at each point is the hands-off default.

options.label: A ticket
options.summary: Resolve a ticket through the configured ticket command.
options.change: In develop.declaration.json, set workflow.input.fields to { "ticket": { "type": "ticket" } }. In develop.ts use ticketInput(request) from develop/report.ts to pass the resolved ticket text to the turn.

options.label: A task text
options.summary: Develop the submitted prompt without a ticket lookup.
options.change: In develop.declaration.json, set workflow.input.fields to { "prompt": { "type": "string" } }. In develop.ts replace ticketInput with promptInput in the import and call. promptInput(request) passes the submitted text without a ticket lookup.

points.question: Who selects the next ticket or task?

options.label: The queue
options.summary: Select a ready ticket through the configured next-ticket command.
options.change: In develop.declaration.json, set workflow.queue to true ("queue": true).

options.label: A person
options.summary: A person submits the ticket or task when starting a run.
options.change: In develop.declaration.json, remove the workflow.queue field.

options.label: Greptile at 5/5
options.summary: Open or update the pull request and wait for Greptile to accept its commit at 5/5.
options.change: In develop/accept.ts call reviewByAgent({ subject, reviewer: { kind: "greptile" } }). develop/round.ts opens or updates the pull request first and passes its immutable commit and target as subject. Declare github wait-review.

options.label: A person
options.summary: Wait for a person's approval of the immutable commit. Denial with feedback requests another bounded turn.
options.change: In develop/accept.ts replace the import and call with reviewByPerson({ subject }). Remove reviewer and github wait-review from the declaration. develop/local.ts already uses reviewByPerson with the clean full commit from the worker report and the run target.

options.label: A review turn
options.summary: Run the review profile and require its explicit accept verdict.
options.change: In develop/accept.ts call reviewByAgent({ subject, reviewer: { kind: "turn", profile: "review" } }). For local merge replace reviewByPerson in develop/local.ts with that same call and its import. Declare claude run-turn:review and configure the review profile. Remove github wait-review from the declaration.

options.label: Cloving after the checks
options.summary: Open or update a pull request and merge after acceptance, the beforeMerge check and CI. Pass result.output into a fix turn on failure.
options.change: Call mergeWhenGreen({ pull, check: "beforeMerge" }) after acceptance. Use the pull returned by opening the pull request. Give the result.output to the next fix turn.

options.label: A person approves Cloving's merge
options.summary: Open or update a pull request, wait for merge approval, then run the beforeMerge check and CI before merging.
options.change: In develop/round.ts replace the mergeWhenGreen import and call with mergeByPerson({ pull, check: "beforeMerge", round }). Use the pull returned by openPull. repair passes the result.output unchanged to the next fix turn.

options.label: A person merges the local branch
options.summary: Leave the accepted branch for a person to merge by hand. Do not push or open a pull request.
options.change: In develop.ts import localRound as developRound from develop/local.ts. Remove the develop/pull.ts import, preparePull, both labelTicket calls and endingRound. The local round reviews the worker report commit, then returns the local branch outcome. Declare only claude capabilities and run-turn methods; include run-turn:review when selected. Do not push or open a pull request.

points.question: What happens when the work is partial?

options.label: Return the ticket to the queue
options.summary: After merging partial work, record the remaining work and set cloving: ready for the first two partial runs. Set cloving: blocked from the third. Stop a run after three fix rounds.
options.change: After a merged result, call protectedEffect with capability: "github", method: "partial-issue", and a payload containing owner, repository, number, pullRequest and remaining. Use an explicit scope with phase, operation and round. The GitHub worker records the partial run and applies ready or blocked.

options.label: A person decides
options.summary: Ask what to do with partial work. Use the answer as feedback for a bounded continuation, or stop and leave it for the person.
options.change: For a pull-request workflow, in develop/round.ts import partialChoice from develop/partial-choice.ts. Immediately after developReport, call partialChoice({ input, round, report }) and return any non-null result. develop/local.ts already does this. The helper calls waitForDecision({ gateId: partialGateId, kind: "question", prompt: partialQuestion }); an explicit answer feeds the next bounded turn and an empty answer stops.
